decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting builds on our robust specialist lighting and LED controls, so we can assimilate and improve it despite marine-specific uncertainty.
General interior lighting is core to our existing knowledge and shows steady market presence, so we can learn from and improve it.
Pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics leverages our optical and interior lighting expertise and is still being actively promoted.
Marine searchlight is less central but related to our robust lighting technology, and we keep it as we can interpret its results and apply our R&D.
